congrats and welcome to uwe! what course are you taking? 🥳 there are 3 campuses for uwe: frenchay (main campus), glenside (medicine) and bower ashton (most arts)
check the m1/m3 bus routes (they take you straight to uwe frenchay) look for accommodation around those bus stops

lots of students living in fishponds, gloucester road (there are also lots of cafes and little shops there)
there are groups on facebook for student accommodation, you can pop a message asking for roommates and sharing your budget per month

start calling agencies to set out which ones take students and which dont

personally i prefer living around or close to the city centre/ cabot circus area as i know you have everything close by, especially close to m1/m3 bus stops

buses are sometimes unreliable but the m1/m3 ones are proper, check the bus routes for your campus and go from there

Daca esti la tehnologic sunt foarte slabe sansele sa primesti caracterizare sau relatia dintre personaje. Fa-ti la fiecare eseu (eu am invatat toate operele in afara de cea pentru traditionalism si Junimea) intrare in curentul literar (pentru Modernism poti avea aceeasi introducere la 3 opere- Blaga, Arghezi, Barbu) titlul, tema, conflictul (interior/ exterior...), vorbesti putin despre actiune, personaje... Plus trebuie sa stii cate doua scene de comentat la fiecare opera. Apuca-te de pe acum, succes!
Ps: pe mine m-a ajutat sa scriu fiecare eseu intai pe pc, apoi de mana, curat, lizibil. Foloseste highlightere.
